# openmetadata_data_contract (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata data contract. A contract describes the terms of use, quality expectations, and effective period of a table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_database_service" "warehouse" {
  name         = "warehouse"
  service_type = "Postgres"
}

resource "openmetadata_database" "analytics" {
  name    = "analytics"
  service = openmetadata_database_service.warehouse.name
}

resource "openmetadata_database_schema" "public" {
  name     = "public"
  database = openmetadata_database.analytics.fully_qualified_name
}

resource "openmetadata_table" "users" {
  name            = "users"
  database_schema = openmetadata_database_schema.public.fully_qualified_name
  description     = "One row per registered user."

  columns = [
    {
      name             = "id"
      data_type        = "BIGINT"
      ordinal_position = 1
    },
    {
      name             = "email"
      data_type        = "VARCHAR"
      data_length      = 255
      ordinal_position = 2
    },
  ]
}

resource "openmetadata_data_contract" "users" {
  name            = "users-monthly-reporting"
  entity          = openmetadata_table.users.fully_qualified_name
  display_name    = "Users monthly reporting"
  description     = "Contract governing the users table for monthly reporting."
  terms_of_use    = "Only consume this table for internal reporting."
  effective_from  = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  effective_until = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity` (String) Fully qualified name of the table governed by the contract. Changing it replaces the contract.
- `name` (String) Data contract name. Changing it replaces the contract.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the contract.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `effective_from` (String) Start of the contract's effective period in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
- `effective_until` (String) End of the contract's effective period in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z.
- `terms_of_use` (String) Terms of use content for the contract.

### Read-Only

- `entity_status` (String) Server-computed status of the governed entity, for example Active.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Server-assigned fully qualified name of the contract.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_data_contract.users 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.database.schema.table.contract.
terraform import openmetadata_data_contract.users warehouse.analytics.public.users.users-monthly-reporting
```
